greeting: Hiii! 🤖 I'm your FandomVerse guide. What would you like to know?
fallback: Hmm, I don't have an answer for that yet. Try one of the suggested questions, or search the site from the magnifier in the top bar! ✨

faqs.a: Try Frieren for action or Nana for drama. The Anime hub has more picks, characters and trailers! 🌸
The Gaming hub has the latest articles, trailers and character profiles. Star Rail Drifters 2 arrives Nov 7! 🚀
Check the Upcoming Releases panel. Avengers DoomsDay lands Dec 15, The Apothecary Diaries' season 3 on Oct 15 and Ginny and Georgia's season 4 on Jan 21 2026. 🗓️
The Media Hub collects trailers, interviews, podcasts and fan videos from every category. You can filter by category and release status. 🍿
The K-Pop hub has debut spotlights, music videos, tour news and fan meetups. 🌟

faqs.q: 📚 Do you cover comics and manga?
faqs.a: Yes! Both have their own hubs with articles, galleries and character profiles. 💥📖
Browse the merchandise, tap Add, and the cart total updates instantly. It's a demo cart, so there's no checkout or payment. 🧢
Tap the bookmark on any article, character, media item or event. Bookmarks stay saved in your browser, and personal notes last for the current session. You can also export your list. 🔖

faqs.q: 🔍 How do I search or filter?
faqs.a: Use the magnifier in the top bar to search everything. On a category page you can filter by content type and tags, and sort by A-Z, newest or popular. 🔎
See Event Highlights for conventions, watch parties and meetups, both past and upcoming. 🎉
Nope! Everything is so open to browse. 😊

faqs.q: 💬 How do I contact the team?
faqs.a: Head to the Contact Us page for the team's details and a map. There's also an About Us page about the project. 💌
